No. 1946/11 – TUESDAY, DECEMBER 22, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
No. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7
Ref. No.: WEG/LAN/LI/ACQ/49.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:

Description of the Land to be acquired: Lands depicted in the survey plan bearing No. F. V. MR/2635, situated in the village of Pelana in Grama Niladari Division of Pelana West, Polwatta in Divisional Secretary’s division of Weligama, Matara district. This acquisition is made for the Reconstruction of Polwatta bridge.

1. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Chettige Koratuwa; Description: Home Garden, 03 Coconut trees about 6-70 years old and 02 Mahogani trees about 30 years old; Claimant: W. Janaka Chandra Kumara, ‘Chandra Nivasa’ Polwatta, Denipitiya; Extent: 0.0112 Hectare.
2. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Anadigewatta; Description: Open barren land; Claimant: P. D. Ramyalatha, No. 8, Polwatta, Denipitiya; Extent: 0.0031 Hectare.
3. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: —; Description: Road; Claimant: Original claimant cannot be found; Extent: 0.0023 Hectare.
4. Lot No. 4 Name of the Land: Anadigewatta; Description: Open barren land; Claimant: D. W. J. K. Weeraman, No. 29, Kankanappulawatta, Polwatta, Denipitiya; Extent: 0.0174 Hectare.
5. Lot No. 5 Name of the Land: Anadigewatta; Description: Open barren land; Claimant: A part of old river in Filed paper No. O 24/37; Extent: 0.0222 Hectare.
6. Lot No. 6 Name of the Land: Kadiyawatta; Description: Open barren land; Claimant: S. P. Samarasinghe, No. 501, Matara Road, Pelana, Weligama; Extent: 0.0691 Hectares.
7. Lot No. 7 Name of the Land: Gangaaddara Watta; Description: Open barren land; Claimant: L. M. Chaminda, No. 8, Abhimangama, Weligama; Extent: 0.0291 Hectare.

8. Lot No. 8 Name of the Land: Polgahanaruppa; Description: Opend barren land; Claimant: N. K. M. Samarasinghe, S. P. Samarasinghe, T. D. Samarasinghe and I. U. Samarasinghe, No. 501, Matara Road, Pelana, Weligama; Extent: 0.0224 Hectare.

12. Lot No. 12 Name of the Land: Mirissage Parana Gedarawatta alias Mirissagewatta; Description: Road; Claimant: M. T. A. Jayaweera, No. 277/D, Sudarshana Mawatha, Malambe and H. W. Dhammika, ‘Vipula’ Polwatta Road, Weligama; Extent: 0.0017 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Weligama of the 24th February, 2016 at 9.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 10th day of February 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K. P. G. SUMITH SHANTHA, Divisional Secretary, Weligama.
